concerns.text: The plan (and FR‑010 in the spec) proposes a *paired t‑test on variance differences between entropy‑matched prompt pairs* to verify that higher entropy leads to higher activation variance. Matching prompts by nearest‑neighbor entropy makes the paired differences expected to be small, rendering the test ill‑posed and effectively circular. A paired t‑test is inappropriate for testing a monotonic relationship; a correlation test (already planned) or a group‑wise comparison (high vs. low entropy) should be used instead.
